Name: Wolfy the white shiba _reskin of  Dawns Fluffy Dogs and Other Alternative Dogs for Adopt and Skin
Author: NightshadowCat93
Description:
More realistic coloring for white shibas cuz I couldn't find one. Please note that this is just a recolor of @dawnblairr's shiba sprites.

To use this you'll need the "Adopt & Skin" mod, copy/paste the png file in the dog folder and name it Dog_1
If you want to convert this for Alternative Textures, go ahead!

Enjoy
